features.name: Multiplier trail
features.description: Every fourth fisherman retriggers 10 spins and raises the multiplier up to 10x.

review:
The fisherman picks up a chainsaw. Infected bugs and dead bass fill a 5x3 grid, and the possessed angler is both wild and collector.

Three, four or five scatters give 10, 15 or 20 free spins, and before each bonus one random modifier is picked – extra collectors, more cash fish or extra spins – so every round starts a bit differently. Every fourth fisherman retriggers and raises the multiplier up to 10x. Up to 5,000x and a strong 96.71% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
